title: Chapter 550 - 550 Promotion; Doing Business!
content:
Chapter 550 - 550 Promotion; Doing Business!

Chapter 550 - 550 Promotion; Doing Business!

550 Promotion; Doing Business!

Wang Tong believed that she had a pair of sharp eyes that could see through men. She could easily discover a man’s financial status.

She looked at his watch.

Then, she looked at his clothes.

Finally, she looked at his shoes.

The poor played with cars, the rich played with watches.

As long as a man had some money, especially a young man, he would definitely wear a luxury model watch! Not to mention the likes of Patrick Phillippe, Vacheron Constantin, and Rolex… At the very least, it should be a Longines, right?

Lin Fan was wearing an electronic watch!

How ridiculous!

He was not afraid of losing face!

Wang Tong did not know that Lin Fan had dozens of watches worth millions of yuan, such as Vacheron Constantin watches and Patek Philippe watches!

However, Lin Fan did not wear any of them because those watches could only tell the time.

How could it compare to a super smart watch?

…

Clothes made the man.

Clothes represented a man’s taste.

In Wang Tong’s opinion, taste was equivalent to big brands!

Rich men should wear LV, Prada, Armani…

If it was sportswear, it would at least be Nike or Adidas, right?

But what about Lin Fan?

He did not wear any branded items.

He probably got his outfit from street stalls!

How would Wang Tong know that Lin Fan was wearing custom-made clothes made by the famous LV designer, Lawrence Hatton. There was no logo on his clothes, and they were not sold on the market.

Naturally, she did not know about it!

…

Shoes were a man’s foundation!

In Wang Tong’s opinion, any man with a little money had to at least have good shoes!

Even if he did not wear Gucci, Hermes, LV… At the very least, he should wear Chanel, right?

What about Lin Fan?

His shoes were not branded!

It was probably another street stall item!

Wang Tong did not know that the shoes were also custom-made for him.

However, this time, they were designed by Gucci’s famous designer, Harston.

After all, Lin Fan was a shareholder of both LV and Gucci!

LV had sent a professional designer, so how could Gucci dare to fall behind?

…

Wang Tong was completely unaware of all of this.

However, in her eyes, she had already seen through everything about Lin Fan.

He was a loser!

Wang Tong rolled her eyes and laughed disdainfully. “So you’re Xinyue’s senior from high school…

“Mr. Lin, are you working in Jiangbei?”

Lin Fan said, “You can say so.”

This sentence was partly perfunctory and partly true.

This was because he had the largest shares in companies such as Xiao Wu Wholesale City and Yinshan Group.

Even though he only took the dividends, he was also holding onto the title of director of these companies. It could be considered as working.

Li Xinyue looked at Lin Fan curiously.

Was Brother Lin not studying at Jiangbei University?

Why was he working now?

Of course, Li Xinyue did not ask too much.

“Then today is a good opportunity!” Wang Tong said with a smile.

“You might not know, but Mr. Tan Jiayou next to me is the young master of the famous Waffle Corporation. As long as you build a good relationship with him, there’ll definitely be no problem for you to be promoted and get a raise in the future!

“Oh right, Jiayou, is your family’s Waffle Corporation going public soon?”

First, she mentioned the young master, then the listed company, which raised Tan Jiayou to a very high position.

Promotion and raise?

Li Xinyue blinked her big eyes and remained silent.

She knew that Lin Fan had a supercar and that he could easily look for the association director, Li Quan.

He even took out a very magical potion that instantly cured her father’s injuries.

Everything showed that Lin Fan did not lack money at all.

Tan Jiayou raised his head and pretended to be casual. “Three years at the latest. Waffle Corporation is already in the process of an IPO.”

Wang Tong immediately opened her mouth wide and praised, “This is too amazing!”

This praise came from Wang Tong’s heart.

She knew very well what going public meant.

It was also possible for his net worth to increase by a hundred times in an instant!

Tan Jiayou still looked like he did not care, but his neck was raised even more.

“Actually, I don’t really care about my family’s company.

“I want to achieve something with my own abilities. That’s why I joined Maple Leaf Ventures. Now, I have some achievements and is a department manager at Maple Leaf Ventures.”

“Not only do you have a good family background, but you’re also so capable!” Wang Tong praised again. “Jiayou, you’re too amazing!”

As she spoke, her eyes seemed to flash with light, and she seemed to have transformed into a fangirl.

“I’m just a manager. It’s not a big deal. I have to become a partner first.” Although Tan Jiayou said that, he could not help but reveal a smug look on his face.

He was that powerful!

Tan Jiayou was lost in the praises. Perhaps even he had forgotten that his family was only fantasizing about going public in three years.

It was still unknown when the company would be listed, or whether it would have a chance to be listed.

As for the position of department manager of Maple Leaf Ventures, he did not get it based on his ability at all. It was directly obtained through his family’s connections.

After Tan Jiayou was pleased with himself, he seemed to realize that Li Xinyue’s senior, Lin Fan, was still beside him.

He glanced at Lin Fan and said, “Mr. Lin, you’re Xinyue’s senior, so you’re my friend. If your work isn’t going well, you can come to my family’s company. I’ll give you twice the salary of your previous company!”

Double the salary?

Lin Fan’s expression turned weird.

One had to know…

In addition to the dividends from companies such as Xiao Wu Wholesale City and Yinshan Group, these companies also specially prepared tens of millions of yuan for his annual salary.

Double the salary?

It was probably 100 billion, right?

Did Waffle Corporation have an annual profit of 100 million?

Tan Jiayou did not wait for Lin Fan’s reply and said, “Of course, if you don’t want to work and want to do business, I can also get Maple Leaf Ventures to get you an investment or something.”

Lin Fan smiled, “Really? I do want to do business.”

“No problem! How much investment do you need?” Tan Jiayou asked.

Lin Fan said, “Let’s test the waters first…”

As he spoke, he extended a finger.

Test the waters?

How much could this be?

10,000?

100,000?

Not to mention the venture capital company, even Tan Jiayou himself could fork out that money.

He immediately said, “Don’t worry. As long as you want it, I can give you the money immediately!”

At this moment, a Lamborghini roared like a ferocious beast and sped over from afar.

When it passed by Lin Fan, the driver stepped on the brakes and stopped beside him.

Then, a man in a checkered shirt quickly got out of the car.

He called out in an extremely excited and respectful voice, “Brother Lin Fan, what a coincidence. I didn’t expect to meet you here!”

As soon as he said that, the entire scene suddenly fell silent.
